name: Opening: Holzer: Wrong Answers
description: Be among the first to see the latest exhibition from Jenny Holzer, an artist known for her challenging and text-based public art.
longDescription:
The latest exhibition from Jenny Holzer, *Wrong Answers*, opens on June 18, 2026. Holzer is an American conceptual artist recognized for her engagement with text and public spaces, often employing LED signs and projections to display provocative statements and truisms. This new collection of work continues her exploration of language, power structures, and societal issues, presented through her distinctive artistic lens.

Visitors to the opening will be among the first to view the new pieces. The atmosphere is expected to be focused on the art, with attendees engaging with Holzer's thought-provoking installations. The exhibition is categorized as art, suggesting a contemplative rather than a boisterous environment. Details regarding the specific venue and its character will vary, but the focus will remain on the artwork itself.

Ticketing information for the opening is not yet available. Details on how to reach the venue, its accessibility, and family-friendliness will be confirmed closer to the event date.
